pokedexEntries.rb: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

pokedexEntries.ye: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.

pokedexEntries.go: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.

pokedexEntries.si: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

pokedexEntries.cr: Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.

pokedexEntries.rs: PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the POKéMON’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.

pokedexEntries.fr: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

pokedexEntries.us: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it’s mostly made of the same material.

pokedexEntries.um: This Pokémon is popular with rich people. It’s also targeted by hunters who are after the jewel in its forehead.

pokedexEntries.sw: Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.
